answers.answer: 1. Four players use 3 randomly chosen Pods; place lowest number in A, next in B, alternate A/B; all Locked side up. 2. Bag: 1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, 3 Adults plus 1 additional Adult per player (7 Adults total).

1. Remove Corporate and Personal Objectives marked for player counts above the actual count; separately shuffle and deal one of each hidden. 2. Receive them before Character draft; choose one of the two at the First Encounter. 3. Remove rejected card face down, unseen by anyone. 4. Eggs are not Intruders and do not trigger the First Encounter choice.

1. Discard the played Action card itself plus exactly two additional Action cards from hand. 2. Contamination cards can never pay Action costs, even though held; they remain in hand unless separately discarded by an allowed rule. 3. For OR sections choose one effect; still discard that card and pay its printed cost.
answers.evidence: Actions: Action Cost; Actions from Action cards

answers.answer: 1. Suffer 1 Light Wound only after finishing your own Player round in the burning Room, including a round ending by passing. 2. After passing, no more normal Actions this Player Phase. 3. On passing, may discard any number of hand cards. 4. Fire damage is assessed at the end of each of your rounds; later rounds you take no further turns once passed, so do not take repeated round damage that turn.

1. Flip the tile face up and resolve its Exploration token; set its Item count by rotating the tile so the token number faces the board's Item Counter (Nest/Slime excluded). 2. Remove the resolved token to the box. 3. If Room is empty, roll Noise; 1–4 places marker in connected numbered Corridor, including Technical Corridor if Entrance. If result is Danger/Silence, apply those effects instead; if anyone (Character or Intruder) already occupies destination, no Noise roll. 4. Silence means no effect, except Slime on Character converts to Danger. Danger moves all neighboring eligible Intruders not in Combat into Room; if none eligible, Noise in every connected Corridor lacking one. Door Exploration places Door in Corridor entered.
answers.evidence: Movement, Rooms, Corridors; Exploration tokens; Noise roll

answers.answer: 1. Careful Movement costs 2 Action cards and replaces the post-move Noise roll with placing Noise in a chosen connected Corridor of destination. 2. Forbidden in Combat and if all connected destination Corridors already have Noise; normal Movement restrictions apply. FAQ says it replaces automatic Silence/Danger results. 3. Closed Door blocks crossing. 4. Characters cannot stop in Corridors; only Rooms (Pods exception) can be occupied.
answers.evidence: Basic Actions; Movement, Rooms, and Corridors

answers.answer: 1. On trying to place Noise where a marker already lies, resolve Encounter: clear all Noise in Corridors connected to Room (Technical if Entrance), draw bag token and place matching miniature. 2. Set non-Blank token aside outside bag; if token causes Intruder to hide in Technical Corridors it returns to bag and loses Injury markers. 3. Compare token number with cards in triggering player's hand; fewer cards than token number causes Surprise Attack. 4. Action and Contamination cards both count for comparison; Contamination still cannot pay costs.

1. Danger moves ALL neighboring Intruders not in Combat with any Character into the Room. 2. If none (or all are in Combat), put Noise in every connected Corridor without a marker. 3. Intruder movement into a Character's Room is not an Encounter; they enter Combat. 4. Character Slime changes Silence to Danger.

1. Blank means no miniature appears; place Noise in every connected Corridor and return Blank to bag. 2. If it was the last token in bag, add an Adult token if one is available, otherwise none. 3. In bag development, Blank adds one Adult token if available and returns Blank to bag; no Encounter/noise specified.

1. Both moving Intruders stay in origin Room. 2. They destroy the Closed Door simultaneously. 3. Destroyed Door lies down and cannot be closed again (except Plasma Torch). 4. If a Noise roll causes an Intruder to appear through a Corridor with a Closed Door, the Door does not block the appearance.

1. Intruder disappears from board upon entering Technical Corridors. 2. Discard all its Injury markers. 3. Return its token to the bag; existing Noise on Technical Corridors stays. 4. Characters cannot use Corridors ordinarily (Mechanic Technical Corridors Action and Technical Corridor Plans exception); Doors cannot be placed there.

1. Shoot costs 1 Action card and 1 Ammo, targets an Intruder in your Room with Weapon in Hand. 2. Melee costs 1 Action card and draws a Contamination card to top of discard before targeting Intruder in Room. 3. Melee miss gives Character 1 Serious Wound; Shoot miss has no wound penalty. 4. Double hit is 2 Injuries for Shoot before weapon modifiers, but only 1 Injury in Melee.

1. Larva dies at 1 Injury. 2. Adult draws one Attack card and dies if blood value ≤ total Injuries; Queen draws two and sums blood, dies if sum ≤ injuries. 3. Dead Adult/Queen places Carcass in Room (Larva does not). 4. If either Queen check card has Retreat arrow, resolve retreat instead of death/endurance: move via Corridor on Event card; Queen retreats if either drawn card has arrow.
answers.evidence: Intruder Injuries and death; Intruder Retreat

answers.answer: 1. Escape is a 1-card Movement; before moving resolve one Intruder Attack per Intruder present, largest first (Queen, Breeder, Adult, Larva). 2. Attack targets escaper. 3. If killed, Corpse stays in Room they tried to leave. 4. If survive, move to neighboring explored/unexplored Room; resolve normal exploration and Noise if destination empty.

1. Intruder targets Character with fewest Action cards; tie goes to First Player token or next in turn order. Surprise Attack targets triggering Character. 2. Draw Attack card for non-Larva: matching type symbol hits/effect; otherwise miss. 3. Larva draws no Attack card. 4. Larva removed from board and placed on Character board; target gets Contamination card atop Action discard. If already has Larva, attacker disappears, existing Larva stays, Character only gains card and does not automatically die.

1. Dressing only suppresses a Serious Wound's effect; it still counts, so at 3 Serious Wounds any additional Wound kills. 2. Third Light Wound clears Light track and causes Serious Wound. 3. Heal removes a Light Wound or a Dressed Serious Wound as effect specifies. 4. On death place Corpse token in Room and drop Heavy Objects there; Item cards disappear from game.
answers.evidence: Character Wounds and death; Rules FAQ 24

answers.answer: 1. Canteen/Shower scan all Contamination cards in hand only; remove non-Infected scanned cards. 2. Infected cards are kept; if no existing Larva place one; if Larva already present, Character dies and Creeper placed in Room. 3. Surgery scans all cards in deck, hand and discard; removes Infected cards and removes Larva if present. 4. Then suffer 1 Light Wound, automatically pass, shuffle entire hand and remaining cards into Action deck; hand empty until next turn.

1. Shoot or Melee attacks uncarried Eggs in your Room; each Injury destroys one Egg. Successful Egg Melee retains ordinary Contamination draw. 2. Grenade destroys 2 Eggs; Molotov 1; Fire destroys 1 uncarried Egg each Fire Damage step (2 with Vulnerability to Fire). 3. Missed Egg Melee causes neither Contamination nor Wound; source leaves timing of normal pre-roll draw unresolved. 4. Noise roll after every single attempt to destroy Egg. Once no Eggs remain on Intruder board, Nest destroyed; mark with Injury.
answers.evidence: Eggs and the Nest; source limitations on missed Egg Melee

answers.answer: 1. Pay 2 cards for Section Room Action; Pod must be unlocked with free Character space; no Intruder or Malfunction in Section; roll Noise and fail if Intruder appears or is present. 2. Resolve Noise before entry. 3. Pod holds 2 Characters; Heavy Objects use no Character space. 4. On boarding may immediately launch; otherwise pass current turn and remain present for bag-development Noise. At start of each later Player Phase choose wait/pass, launch, or exit free to Section Room and take full 2-Action round. Intruder appearing sends Pod occupants to Room; Malfunction still permits wait/launch/exit but blocks new entry.

1. Engines → Coordinates → Contamination → Objectives. 2. Two or three Damaged Engines explode ship; everyone aboard dies, Pod passengers away. 3. Non-Earth kills hibernating Characters; Quarantine sleeper survives Mars. Ship is not destroyed and Intruders remain alive from non-Earth destination. 4. Every survivor, including Pod passenger: if no Larva, scan all Contamination cards from deck/hand/discard; only if any Infected (or Larva present) shuffle all Action and Contamination together and draw four; any Contamination in four kills. 5. Yes, Pod passengers undergo this check.

1. Random face-down Room 2 tiles fill 2 slots; Room 1 tiles fill 1 slots; random unseen Exploration token on each tile; extras returned unseen. 2. Random Coordinates face down Cockpit; Destination marker starts B; Time marker green. 3. Each of three Engines gets shuffled face-down Working and Damaged tokens stacked, top is true status. 4. Intruder board starts 5 Eggs and 3 random face-down Weaknesses.

1. Random Help card numbered to player count assigns number/order. 2. In number order each draws two Character draft cards publicly, keeps one, shuffles other back. 3. Each gets board, miniature in Hibernatorium, shuffled 10 Action cards, Starting Weapon in Hand loaded to capacity, and two Quest Items horizontal beside board; blue Corpse starts Hibernatorium. 4. Quest Items are not active until mini-quest condition flips them.

1. Start Player Phase draw to 5, then pass First Player token left except first game turn. 2. If draw needed with empty Action deck, shuffle discard into new deck then draw. 3. Action discards face up to own discard; Contamination atop it, cannot pay; normal discards face up. Item cards go matching Item discard, Event/Attack/Wound to their respective discard; normal visibility face up. Search rejected Item goes face down bottom of chosen deck.

1. Advance Time (and Self-Destruct if active), Intruder Attacks, Fire damage/checks, Event movement, Event effect, bag development. 2. On Event move all Intruders of card symbol that are not in a Room with Characters. 3. They move to neighboring Room through Corridor number on card; Technical Corridor sends token to bag. Resolve card effect after movement. 4. Empty Event deck reshuffles discards; empty Intruder Attack deck reshuffles its discard.

1. Larva removed from bag, add Adult; Creeper removed, add Breeder; Adult returns immediately before all players roll Noise in order (skip Combat); Breeder prompts Noise rolls then returns. 2. Queen in Nest places miniature and Encounter; otherwise add Egg to board; Queen returns. 3. Blank adds Adult if available, then returns. 4. Adult/Breeder Noise rolls happen as specified; turn begins only after all development and resulting Encounters/Surprise Attacks resolve.

1. Attempting ninth Fire or Malfunction marker ends game: ship explodes/loses hull integrity. 2. Max one per Room; extra placements where Room already has marker do nothing. 3. Discarded markers return to appropriate pool. 4. Hull loss kills all aboard, awake or hibernating, plus Intruders and everything else aboard.
answers.evidence: Fire and Malfunction markers; End game

answers.answer: 1. Malfunction makes Room Action and its Computer unavailable. 2. Searching still works; repair can remove marker. 3. Never placed in Nest, Room Covered With Slime, or unexplored Room. 4. Does not change Engine token/status; Hibernatorium Malfunction does not affect already-hibernated Character.

1. Normal Item cards hidden in card holder; others see backs/colors. 2. No Inventory size limit; show any Item when used. 3. Heavy Items/Objects are visible and occupy one of two Hand slots; max two carried. 4. Heavy Objects include Egg, Corpse, Carcass. Weapons searched start with 1 Ammo; never exceed printed capacity. Add Items attach to another card and count as one. Duct Tape combines two Heavy Items into one Hand slot, not Objects.

1. Dropped Objects stay in Room; dropped Items are lost/discarded. 2. Drop free at any time during your turn, no Action. 3. Searched Weapons come with 1 Ammo; starting Weapon loaded to its printed capacity.

1. Search uses Room color: Red/Yellow/Green matching; white lets choose any. Draw 2 from one deck, keep 1. 2. Return rejected card face down to bottom of that deck. 3. Each Search lowers Item Counter by 1; at zero cannot use Search Action, except Scout Scavenging. 4. Special Rooms do not permit Searching; Blue Crafted Items cannot be searched for.

1. Craft Item Basic Action costs one Action card plus discard two Item cards with blue Component icons matching result's gray icons. 2. Result must be available in Craft deck. 3. May inspect Craft deck at any time. 4. Antidote flame+medical cross; Taser battery/lightning+tool; Flamethrower flame+tool; Molotov flame+fabric.

1. Only initiator pays one Action card; any Characters in Room may agree to trade with each other. 2. May give Item/Object for nothing, but empty no-intent trade disallowed; honest negotiation can end without exchange. 3. Characters cannot exchange Ammo. 4. Heavy Items found by Searching need no separate Pick Up Action; pickup Basic Action is for Heavy Objects.
answers.evidence: Trade; FAQ Actions 1–2; Items and Objects

answers.answer: 1. Research corresponding Object: Corpse, Intruder Carcass, or Egg. 2. Object must be present in Laboratory. 3. Object is retained, not consumed; Weakness revealed face up on Intruder board. 4. All players benefit. For Discover Weakness Objective, anyone may research it before game end; you need not do it personally.

1. Usually in that Room, cost 2 Action cards; forbidden in Combat or Room with Malfunction. 2. Computer icon itself does nothing except indicate a Computer that a Malfunction disables / Computer-dependent abilities use. 3. Fire does not prevent Room Actions or Searching; character wound applies when ending own round in Fire.
1. Armory adds 2 Ammo to one of your Energy Weapons. 2. Not Classic Weapons and cannot exceed printed Ammo capacity.

1. Choose one: Dress all Serious Wounds; Heal one Dressed Serious Wound; or Heal all Light Wounds. 2. Dressing flips card face down and ignores effect, does not remove wound/count. 3. Identical Serious Wound effects do not stack, though each counts toward three-wound limit.
1. Send Signal places a Status marker on your Character board's Signal space; used only for relevant Objective. 2. Comms Room is always aboard in standard setup.

1. Fire Control chooses any one Room and discards its Fire marker if present. 2. All Intruders there run away in random directions by drawing an Event card per Intruder; works even if Room had no Fire.

1. Generator starts by placing marker on first green space; stopping removes marker; new sequence restarts at green. 2. Advances one space with Time each turn; first yellow makes it unstoppable and unlocks Pods once; final skull explodes ship. Later yellow does not unlock again if relocked. 3. If jump occurs while active, ship is considered destroyed. 4. Character cannot initiate while anyone hibernates; Coolant Leak Event can. Hibernating Characters die on destruction.

1. Target any one OTHER Yellow Room. 2. Its connected Corridors must contain no Destroyed Doors. 3. Automatically close every Door around it and place Procedure token there. 4. At current Player Phase end, if all Doors remain closed, everything in Room dies and Fire marker removed; opening any Door first cancels.
1. At start of new turn, Character in Cabins with no Intruders draws one extra Action card (hand 6). 2. Malfunction disables it. 3. Passive, not a paid Room Action.

1. Command Center can choose any Room, including distant. 2. Open/Close any chosen Doors in its connected Corridors; choice need not be uniform. 3. Destroyed Door cannot be closed again except Plasma Torch, so not closable by this action.

1. Engine Control Room checks status of all three Engines; cannot change them. 2. Works even if an Engine Room has Malfunction; Engine Room Malfunction affects Room Action only and never Engine status.

1. Hatch Control flips one Pod token between Locked and Unlocked. 2. Monitoring secretly looks at any one unexplored Room tile and Exploration token. 3. You may lie about what saw; then replace both tile and token in same location.
answers.evidence: Room Actions: Hatch Control; Monitoring Room

answers.answer: 1. Entering Room Covered With Slime automatically places Slime marker; no separate Action. 2. No Item count set; Malfunction cannot be placed. 3. Slime max one; further does nothing. 4. Shower removes Slime but does not extinguish Fire.
answers.evidence: Room Covered With Slime; Shower Room

answers.answer: 1. Cockpit allows secretly check Coordinates or set Destination by moving marker. 2. Check is private; may lie and replace card. 3. Marker selects one of four destination entries on Coordinates card. 4. Cannot Set Destination with Intruder in Cockpit or change after anyone hibernates.

1. Check Engine secretly views top token. Repair/Break examines both and restacks in any order using Repairs Action or Tools Item. 2. You need not say whether repaired. 3. Must announce if order changed. 4. No prior check or functioning Engine Room required; works despite Malfunction.

1. May hibernate only Time blue, present in Hibernatorium, no Intruder or Malfunction there; cost 2 Action cards. 2. Roll Noise; if Intruder appears/reaches room attempt fails. 3. Success removes miniature and player stops participating until end checks. 4. After anyone hibernates no Character can change Destination or initiate Self-Destruct; Coolant Leak Event exception. Later Malfunction does not wake/harm sleeper.

1. Time final red: immediate hyperspace jump; every nonhibernating Character aboard dies. 2. Last alive, nonhibernating Character dies/hibernates/launches: end game. 3. If Self-Destruct active, advance to final red; otherwise Time to final red, resolve effect. 4. Intruders unharmed by normal jump; they die if ship explodes.

1. Characters cannot directly attack another Character. 2. Indirect harm is possible: lock someone in burning Room, activate Self-Destruct with crew aboard, or throw Grenade into Room with other crew.

1. If all 8 Adult models on board, remove all Adults not in Combat, return their tokens to bag if possible, then place Adult in Encounter Room. If all 8 in Combat summary expressly says procedure unresolved. 2. Intruder entering unexplored Room by movement remains there; do not reveal tile or Exploration token.
answers.evidence: Adult overflow; Intruders in unexplored Rooms

answers.answer: 1. Small curled symbol hits Larva/Creeper only; other Shoot targets are missed. 2. Larger curved hits Larva/Creeper/Adult; misses Breeder/Queen. 3. In Melee same target eligibility applies; ineligible target is a miss and Character suffers 1 Serious Wound.

1. With no Larva, scan every Contamination card in deck/hand/discard. 2. If none Infected, do not shuffle/draw four; do not remove non-Infected cards. 3. Earlier launched Pod still undergoes final Contamination check and Objective check.
1. Flame + medical cross. 2. Battery/lightning + screwdriver/tool. 3. Flame + screwdriver/tool. 4. Flame + folded cloth/fabric.

1. In Combat whenever Intruder in your Room. 2. Apply explicit In Combat Only/Out of Combat Only restrictions. Basic Actions in Combat limited to Shoot, Melee, Basic Movement as Escape; Room Actions forbidden. 3. Unmarked card/Item Actions usable in or out subject to requirements. 4. Eggs are not Intruders and do not cause Combat.

1. Must be dead by end; do not have to kill personally. 2. Hibernating or escaped Character counts as surviving, so does not satisfy cannot survive. 3. Only survivor means no other Character survives. 4. Regardless, your own Character must survive and fulfill Objective.

1. If pool empty, move any Door token from elsewhere on board. 2. Open is no token; Closed is standing token; Destroyed lying token. 3. Max one per Corridor. 4. Doors never placed in Technical Corridors.

1. On first Character death all Escape Pods automatically unlock immediately. 2. This applies to every Pod. 3. They may later be locked/unlocked normally through Hatch Control etc.; summary notes ambiguity about whether later deaths re-unlock after relocking, but this question asks subsequent locking: yes, Pods may subsequently be Locked again.

1. Room Action draws 2 cards from chosen Red/Yellow/Green deck and keeps one. 2. Other returned face down to bottom of that deck. 3. Room Actions cost 2 Action cards, require in Room, forbidden in Combat or Malfunction. Storage can be used repeatedly even at Item Counter zero; counter limits Search Action card only.

1. While in Nest, Room Action removes one Egg token from Intruder board and costs 2 Action cards. 2. Then roll Noise. 3. A dropped Egg is a Heavy Object in Room picked up with Pick Up Heavy Object Basic Action (1 card); it is no longer represented on Intruder board and returning it to Nest does not restore Nest total.

answers.answer: 1. Pay required Action-card cost and show Item card when used. 2. One Use Only Item card is discarded after use to appropriate Item discard pile.
answers.evidence: Actions from Item cards; Discard piles

answers.answer: 1. Launched Pod occupants count as arriving on Earth. 2. This does not establish that ship reached Earth; ship destination is separately determined by Coordinates and Destination marker.
1. Yes. Waiting Pod occupant remains treated as present in Section for Noise rolls from bag development.
1. You may still wait, launch, or exit to Section Room. 2. Malfunction only blocks new entry to Pods; it does not prevent already-waiting occupants' choices.
1. One separate Intruder Attack per Intruder in Room. 2. Resolve largest first: Queen, Breeder, Adult, Larva.
1. Yes. Event that instructs removal from game is removed even if its other effect cannot resolve.
1. Drawn Adult returns to bag immediately before all players roll Noise. 2. Therefore an Encounter from those rolls may draw that same Adult token.

1. Retreating Intruder meeting Closed Door destroys Door and stays. 2. With The Way of Moving Weakness, affected Intruder except Breeder/Queen does nothing at Door; door remains per this special rule.

answers.answer: 1. No. Hand Serious Wound does not increase Basic Shoot cost because Shoot is a Basic Action, not an Item Action.
1. Vulnerability to Fire adds 1 Injury per damage instance (x+1), not per injury in that instance. 2. Flamethrower double-crosshair hit deals 3 Injuries.
1. Attacking Larva is removed from board/disappears. 2. Existing Larva stays. 3. Character gains Contamination card but is not automatically killed.
1. No later Fire wounds in Hibernatorium. 2. Ship destruction still kills sleepers; destination/contamination endgame checks also apply to determine survival.

1. Discarded/dead Intruder tokens return to unused token pool. 2. They remain reusable, not removed permanently.
1. Fire may be placed in unexplored Rooms. 2. Malfunction may not be placed in unexplored Rooms.

1. Heavy Objects drop in Room. 2. Item cards disappear from game.

1. Ship destruction fulfills kill-Queen and destroy-Nest requirements. 2. That alone does not win: your Character must still survive and fulfill Objective.

1. Quest activation is a Basic Action printed on card. 2. Forbidden in Combat. 3. Allowed in a Malfunctioning Room; Malfunction prevents Room Action, not Quest Item action.

1. Basic Shoot, Melee and Basic Movement as Escape are permitted. 2. Trade, Craft and Pick Up Heavy Object are not permitted. 3. Unmarked Action-card or Item Actions may be used in Combat if requirements permit; marked restrictions govern. Room Actions forbidden.

1. Full Auto performs one Shoot Action; total damage is Shoot result plus half Ammo discarded (rounded down) plus Assault Rifle +1 bonus. 2. Remove all Ammo from Weapon.

1. May see Intruder Attack card before choosing Nerves of Steel. 2. It can protect Soldier when another Character triggered Surprise Attack, but only Soldier benefits; other Characters still take effects such as Frenzy.

1. Ignore Door Exploration token when entering via Technical Corridors Action or Technical Corridor Plans; entry Corridor cannot be determined, so no Door placement.

1. Object itself must be in Laboratory even if Scientist carries it elsewhere. 2. Research reveals corresponding Weakness; Object is retained, including for Objectives.

1. No Larva is placed; gain a new Contamination card instead.

Gain one new Contamination; reshuffle it with non-Infected scanned Contamination and Action cards, except cards kept in hand. 3. May keep hand cards, then pass. 4. Surgery scans same zones/removes Infected and Larva if present, causes 1 Light Wound and automatic pass; shuffles entire hand too and gives no new Contamination.

1. Slime marker goes on exploring Character board; Fire and Malfunction markers in newly explored Room. 2. Door token goes in Corridor by which entered. Malfunction cannot be placed in unexplored Room; Fire can.

1. No Search Action in Nest. 2. No Search Action in Room Covered With Slime.
